about:
Francis Cable Systems operates from Lakewood, New Jersey, where it was formed in 1978 as a privately held company. The business began producing UL Listed armored cable products in 1995 and has since focused on custom cable manufacturing services for a range of project sizes.

The company manufactures a full line of UL Listed armored cable products and provides custom armoring, twisting, cabling, and wire marking services using its state-of-the-art cabling and wire marking lines. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed, but the operation emphasizes domestic production in New Jersey.

Francis Cable Systems supplies wire and cable to some of the largest projects in the Northeast while also serving small companies that require unique custom armoring concepts on a timely and cost-effective basis. Specific industry sectors are not publicly listed, though the reference to large Northeast projects suggests construction and infrastructure work.

The company highlights its Made-in-USA manufacturing and its ability to deliver custom armoring solutions quickly and affordably, positioning itself as a reliable partner for both large-scale and niche projects. Its privately held structure allows it to participate favorably in a competitive marketplace while maintaining quality standards.
